_comment: Single source of truth for gateway forms. Read by the service (validation, which fields are secret) and bundled into the web app (dashboard configurator and the self-host generator). Field types: text | secret | textarea (key material, secret) | select | check. 'demo' values are published sandbox data and are refused in live mode.

gateways.name: bKash
gateways.get: Apply for a bKash merchant account (PGW / Tokenized Checkout). bKash sends sandbox credentials, then live ones after review.
gateways.sandbox: Ask bKash, or use the community demo profile below.
need: Username and password for the token API
gateways.demoNote: Demo values are widely shared by the community, not published by bKash; they may stop working. Use your own for real tests.

checkout.label: bKash
checkout.hint_bn: আপনার বিকাশ ওয়ালেট থেকে পেমেন্ট করুন

f.help: Change only if bKash tells you to.

gateways.name: Nagad
gateways.get: Contact Nagad merchant onboarding. They email a merchant ID, the Nagad public key, and a pack; you generate your RSA key pair and send them your public key. Live needs your server IP and domain whitelisted.
gateways.sandbox: Through your Nagad account manager only
gateways.test: Sandbox wallet numbers come with the pack
need: Your merchant private key (PEM or bare base64)
Nagad public key (PEM or bare base64)
Your server public IPv4 for whitelisting

checkout.label: Nagad
checkout.hint_bn: আপনার নগদ ওয়ালেট থেকে পেমেন্ট করুন

f.help: Saved to keys/ (git-ignored), never into code.
f.cloudHelp: Stored encrypted. It is never shown again after saving.

f.help: Your whitelisted public IP; customer IP is used when you pass it.
f.cloudHelp: Leave empty to use this service's outbound address.

f.help: Leave empty unless your pack gives a different host or port.

gateways.name: SSLCOMMERZ
gateways.get: Register a free sandbox store at developer.sslcommerz.com/registration; the store ID and password arrive by email. Live needs merchant onboarding.
gateways.test: Use the test cards and mobile banking options shown on the sandbox payment page
need: Store password (API password, not your panel login)
Set the IPN URL in the panel (generated for you)
gateways.demoNote: testbox / qwerty are the sample values from the SSLCOMMERZ docs; register your own sandbox store for working tests.

checkout.label: Card, bank or wallet

f.l: I understand this tool verifies payments to wallet numbers, and that collecting business money into personal wallets breaks MFS terms and may need a Bangladesh Bank licence.
